stench.desc: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

volt-absorb.desc: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.

stall.desc: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.

technician.desc: Powers up the Pokémon’s weaker moves.

leaf-guard.desc: Prevents status conditions in sunny weather.

klutz.desc: The Pokémon can’t use any held items.

mold-breaker.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

super-luck.desc: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

aftermath.desc: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.

anticipation.desc: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon’s dangerous moves.

forewarn.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

unaware.desc: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon’s stat changes.

water-absorb.desc: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move, instead of taking damage.

tinted-lens.desc: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

filter.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

slow-start.desc: For five turns, the Pokémon’s Attack and Speed stats are halved.

scrappy.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

storm-drain.desc: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

ice-body.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm.

solid-rock.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

snow-warning.desc: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm when it enters a battle.

honey-gather.desc: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.

frisk.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s held item.

oblivious.desc: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.

reckless.desc: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

multitype.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate or Z-Crystal it holds.

flower-gift.desc: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies when it is sunny.

bad-dreams.desc: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon.

pickpocket.desc: Steals an item from an attacker that made direct contact.

sheer-force.desc: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.

contrary.desc: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

unnerve.desc: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

defiant.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.

defeatist.desc: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.

cursed-body.desc: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

healer.desc: Sometimes heals an ally’s status condition.

weak-armor.desc: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.

multiscale.desc: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes when its HP is full.

toxic-boost.desc: Powers up physical attacks when the Pokémon is poisoned.

flare-boost.desc: Powers up special attacks when the Pokémon is burned.

harvest.desc: May create another Berry after one is used.

compound-eyes.desc: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy.

telepathy.desc: Anticipates an ally’s attack and dodges it.

moody.desc: Raises one stat sharply and lowers another every turn.

overcoat.desc: Protects the Pokémon from things like sand, hail, and powder.

poison-touch.desc: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

regenerator.desc: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

big-pecks.desc: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.

sand-rush.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a sandstorm.

wonder-skin.desc: Makes status moves more likely to miss.

analytic.desc: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

illusion.desc: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in the party’s last spot.

insomnia.desc: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.

imposter.desc: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it’s facing.

infiltrator.desc: Passes through the opposing Pokémon’s barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.

mummy.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.

moxie.desc: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.

justified.desc: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.

rattled.desc: Dark-, Ghost-, and Bug-type moves scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.

magic-bounce.desc: Reflects status moves, instead of getting hit by them.

sap-sipper.desc: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move, instead of taking damage.

prankster.desc: Gives priority to a status move.

sand-force.desc: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

color-change.desc: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

iron-barbs.desc: Inflicts damage to the attacker on contact with iron barbs.

zen-mode.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s shape when HP is half or less.

victory-star.desc: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

turboblaze.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

teravolt.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

aroma-veil.desc: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.

flower-veil.desc: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.

cheek-pouch.desc: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

protean.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

fur-coat.desc: Halves the damage from physical moves.

immunity.desc: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.

magician.desc: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.

bulletproof.desc: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

competitive.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.

strong-jaw.desc: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.

refrigerate.desc: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

sweet-veil.desc: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.

stance-change.desc: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.

gale-wings.desc: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is full.

mega-launcher.desc: Powers up aura and pulse moves.

grass-pelt.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat in Grassy Terrain.

flash-fire.desc: Powers up the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves if it’s hit by one.

symbiosis.desc: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.

tough-claws.desc: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

pixilate.desc: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

gooey.desc: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.

dark-aura.desc: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.

fairy-aura.desc: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.

aura-break.desc: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.

shield-dust.desc: This Pokémon’s dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.

stamina.desc: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.

wimp-out.desc: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

emergency-exit.desc: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.

water-compaction.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.

merciless.desc: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

shields-down.desc: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon’s shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

stakeout.desc: Doubles the damage dealt to the target’s replacement if the target switches out.

water-bubble.desc: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

drizzle.desc: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

own-tempo.desc: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.

berserk.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.

slush-rush.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a hailstorm.

long-reach.desc: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

liquid-voice.desc: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

triage.desc: Gives priority to a healing move.

schooling.desc: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.

disguise.desc: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.

suction-cups.desc: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.

corrosion.desc: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it’s a Steel or Poison type.

comatose.desc: It’s always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.

queenly-majesty.desc: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

innards-out.desc: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.

dancer.desc: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.

battery.desc: Powers up ally Pokémon’s special moves.

fluffy.desc: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

dazzling.desc: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

intimidate.desc: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.

soul-heart.desc: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.

receiver.desc: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

beast-boost.desc: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.

rks-system.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

electric-surge.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

psychic-surge.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

misty-surge.desc: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

grassy-surge.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

shadow-tag.desc: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadow to prevent it from escaping.

full-metal-body.desc: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

shadow-shield.desc: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

prism-armor.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.

rough-skin.desc: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.

wonder-guard.desc: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

levitate.desc: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

effect-spore.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.

synchronize.desc: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.

clear-body.desc: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.

speed-boost.desc: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.

natural-cure.desc: All status conditions heal when the Pokémon switches out.

lightning-rod.desc: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.

serene-grace.desc: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.

swift-swim.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in rain.

chlorophyll.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in sunshine.

illuminate.desc: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon by illuminating the surroundings.

trace.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon’s Ability.

poison-point.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

inner-focus.desc: The Pokémon’s intensely focused, and that protects the Pokémon from flinching.

battle-armor.desc: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

magma-armor.desc: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

water-veil.desc: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

magnet-pull.desc: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping using its magnetic force.

soundproof.desc: Soundproofing of the Pokémon itself gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.

rain-dish.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

sand-stream.desc: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

pressure.desc: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.

thick-fat.desc: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

early-bird.desc: The Pokémon awakens twice as fast as other Pokémon from sleep.

flame-body.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

sturdy.desc: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.

run-away.desc: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

keen-eye.desc: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon’s accuracy.

hyper-cutter.desc: The Pokémon’s proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

pickup.desc: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

truant.desc: The Pokémon can’t use a move the following turn if it uses one.

hustle.desc: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

cute-charm.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

plus.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

minus.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

forecast.desc: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

damp.desc: Prevents the use of explosive moves such as Self-Destruct by dampening its surroundings.

sticky-hold.desc: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

shed-skin.desc: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

guts.desc: It’s so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat.

marvel-scale.desc: The Pokémon’s marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.

liquid-ooze.desc: Oozed liquid has strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.

overgrow.desc: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.

blaze.desc: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.

torrent.desc: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.

swarm.desc: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.

rock-head.desc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

limber.desc: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.

drought.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

vital-spirit.desc: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

white-smoke.desc: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

pure-power.desc: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

shell-armor.desc: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

tangled-feet.desc: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

motor-drive.desc: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.

rivalry.desc: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

sand-veil.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasion in a sandstorm.

steadfast.desc: The Pokémon’s determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.

gluttony.desc: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.

anger-point.desc: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

unburden.desc: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon’s held item is used or lost.

heatproof.desc: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.

simple.desc: The stat changes the Pokémon receives are doubled.

dry-skin.desc: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in sunshine, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

download.desc: Compares an opposing Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

static.desc: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.

poison-heal.desc: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned, instead of losing HP.

adaptability.desc: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

skill-link.desc: Maximizes the number of times multi-strike moves hit.

hydration.desc: Heals status conditions if it’s raining.

solar-power.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in sunny weather, but HP decreases every turn.

quick-feet.desc: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

normalize.desc: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.

sniper.desc: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.

magic-guard.desc: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

no-guard.desc: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
